title: data for nudge.clear
description: The board's own task supervisor (src/supervisor.mjs) closes an escalation chain whose condition no longer holds (the lane resumed, the owner answered, the dossier was marked, the idle episode ended). Target = the chain's head; ids = the open nudges of the chain. Written only by the board itself: no role may send it.

reason.description: condition_cleared: the condition is gone; superseded: a re-nudge of the same chain replaced these open links (src/supervisor.mjs rearmCandidates).
